evidence: Adds functional tests for the decodepsbt RPC method in test/functional/rpc_psbt.py.
rationale: Adds test coverage verifying that decodepsbt properly rejects unsupported PSBT_GLOBAL_VERSION values and falls back to version 0. The author demonstrated that modifying PSBT_HIGHEST_VERSION triggered zero existing test failures, making this worthwhile coverage against RPC decode regressions.
